summary.en: A second model rewrites the final reply in the style of your prompt. The history page shows success rate, latency, filters, a side-by-side view, compare, retry, and copy as JSON or Markdown. Nothing is written back into the session.
summary.zh: 另一个模型按你的提示词转述最终回复。翻译记录页有成功率、延迟、筛选、并排、对比、重试，以及复制为 JSON 或 Markdown。不会写回原会话。
